result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears clipped mid-character, a category chip on the right edge is cut off with no visible label, and horizontally scrolled card titles are truncated without ellipsis.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is visually clipped — the final 'n' is cut off, rendering as 'Tokumaru Rameı'. There is ample horizontal space before the rating, so this looks like an incorrect width constraint on the text container rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container width so it uses available space up to the rating element, and apply proper ellipsis truncation only when text genuinely overflows.

issues.description: The last category chip in the filter row (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the right screen edge showing only an empty sliver of a pill, with no partial text visible to hint at more content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the partially visible chip shows some of its label, or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is hard-clipped at the screen edge without an ellipsis, making the name look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card titles to the card width with ellipsis truncation, or ensure the clipped card visibly peeks with consistent cropping to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The search placeholder text and secondary metadata (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min') use light gray on light backgrounds, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text).
